trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and opened a SEV2 incident. The service is healthy again.

**Rollback:**
- **Before:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an error rate of about 18%.
- **Version chosen:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. A human approver signed off on the rollback before it ran.
- **After:** All three regions are on v2.3.0. A status check afterwards shows the service healthy, with the error rate down to about 0.2%.

**Incident:**
- INC-0001 is open as a SEV2 for checkout-api, and on-call has been paged.
- It says what failed, what I rolled back to, and why. It also lists follow-ups: find the root cause in v2.3.1, and find out why it went to production when its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had already been unhealthy in staging.
- My first request to create the incident timed out. The incident list showed nothing had been created, so I sent the request again. That second request is what created INC-0001. Both requests used the same idempotency key, so there won't be a duplicate incident or a second page.
